question: What event at the moment of bodily death marks the final release described here?
premises: The time of bodily fall arrives.
The skull is pierced at that moment.
This event is addressed to the goddess.
inference: At the fall of the body, when the skull is pierced, the decisive moment of release occurs.
uncertainties: The fused form kapālambhidyate is read as kapālam + bhidyate; the doctrinal referent of the piercing is not explicit.
plain_english: O Goddess, when at the fall of the body the skull is pierced, then...
